user.title: Connect to Rittal PDU
user.description: Make sure SNMP is enabled on the PDU (Configuration -> Network -> SNMP) and that this Home Assistant instance is allowed to reach it -- if the PDU restricts SNMP access to specific hosts, add this instance to that allowed list first. The standard SNMP port (161) is used and isn't configurable here.

v1v2_credentials.title: SNMP community
v1v2_credentials.description: For SNMP v1/v2c: enter your read and write communities as configured on the PDU -- they're case-sensitive.

data.write_community: Write community string (leave blank to reuse the read community)

v3_credentials.title: SNMPv3 credentials
v3_credentials.description: Enter the SNMPv3 username and password configured on the PDU.
